company.title: Training platform from Forge Public Safety
company.description: Forge Academy is the training product in the Forge ecosystem — built for fire service academies and regional training sites.
paragraphs: Forge Academy handles registration, class management, skills tracking, enterprise testing, certificates, and campus digital signage.
Academy runs on its own Firebase project and integrates with the broader Forge platform through shared identifiers and APIs — not shared databases.
Campus Signage manages training-site TVs. Department operations displays are configured separately in ForgePS Dashboard once RMS feeds are live.
company.closingDescription: Request a pilot demo or explore the live Academy deployment.
